title: fix(i18n): a tenant-rewritten validation rule message beats the packaged translation, on the refusal and on /meta
body:
domain:server#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgXcN9HaZYSEUdJWEjw

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu74gtDHSKocA9ivK4GcE6a2)_
Fixes #27221

Clause-②: yes (widening) — the exported `scalarOverridesPackagedBase` (`@objectstack/spec/system`) accepts `'message'` as a key, and `ValidationMessageContext` gains the optional `packagedRule` (reached from `EvaluateRulesOptions.messages`); corrected by the seat per contract review 6496586363
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: updated here — content/docs/ui/translations.mdx ("An edit beats the packaged catalog": validation rule messages), prose-only commit e4a45ed8

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：租户在 overlay 里改写了套件自带校验规则的提示语（规则名不变）后，非默认语言下拒收报错和 /meta 都会被套件翻译盖回去；现在两处都只在提示语仍等于套件原句时才套用翻译，改写过的照原样显示，没改的规则照常翻译。
- 为什么改：ADR-0029 D9.2a「显式改写胜过套件默认」在规则提示语上两个读取端都没生效，租户给自己用户改的话一换语言就变回厂商译文。
- 风险与回滚：只收窄「何时套用翻译」，不新增键、不改拒收的 code/field；套件未声明的规则（objectExtensions 带来的）照常翻译。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`（translateObjectValidations 的比较）、`packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts`（authoredRuleMessage）、`packages/objectql/src/engine-validation-messages.ts`（packaged 规则查找）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/engine-validation-tenant-rewrite.test.ts`，预期 3 passed：zh-CN/zh/en 三个语言下 /meta 与拒收给出同一句，改写的规则是租户原句。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（本 PR 触 packages/spec，欠一次 head 上的契约复审）。

## What changes

ADR-0029 D9.2a, applied to validation rule messages on both of their readers, with one comparison.

- **`/meta` (`translateObjectValidations`, `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`).** The overlay of `validations[].message` from `objects.OBJECT._validations.RULE.message` now applies only while the served message still equals the message of the packaged rule of the same name in `TranslateDocumentOptions.packagedBase` (a `conditional` branch by its own name). The test is `valueOverridesPackagedBase`, the predicate the object's scalars, embedded list views and field descriptions already use. The docblock's "No packaged-base comparison" section, which recorded the deliberate deviation of #27202, is replaced.
- **The refusal (`authoredRuleMessage`, `packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts`).** The same rule, through the exported `scalarOverridesPackagedBase`, whose key union gains `'message'`. That widening is the only change to a `@objectstack/spec/system` export: a parameter type accepts one more literal; the behaviour for the three existing keys is unchanged, and no generated artifact moves (`api-surface/system.json` records names, `api-surface-signatures.json` records only the `define*` signatures).
- **The packaged rule (`packages/objectql/src/engine-validation-messages.ts`, `record-validator.ts`, `engine.ts`).** `ValidationMessageContext` gains an optional `packagedRule(ruleName)` lookup. `validationMessageContext` fills it from `SchemaRegistry.getPackagedObjectOwner(name).definition`, the same body `/meta` hands its translator through `getPackagedObjectBase`; the index is built on the first lookup. `engine.ts` changes only the host literal of `ObjectQL#validationMessageContext` (one `registry` getter), added to the claim's file surface by the seat (6495205921). No packaged owner, or a registry that cannot answer, leaves the lookup absent, and the catalog applies as before.

One rule, two readers: `/meta` and the refusal of the same write still show one sentence for one rule and locale, pinned together in `engine-validation-tenant-rewrite.test.ts`.

## Why

A tenant who reworded a packaged rule's message for their own users saw it reverted to the vendor's translation as soon as a user's locale had a bundle entry, on the server's refusal and on the served form. The refusal half predates #27202; the `/meta` half followed from #27202 keeping the two readers identical (triage 6468439288: "One precedence rule, used by both readers").

## Tests

Red first (commit `7976cc1a`, tests only, on `origin/main` `57c51aab4`):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/system/i18n-resolver.object-validations.test.ts`: 3 failed / 13 passed (16). The three new `/meta` cases failed; the 13 #27135 cases passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/validation/rule-validator.test.ts src/engine-validation-tenant-rewrite.test.ts`: 4 failed / 192 passed (196). The rewrite cases on the evaluator failed, and so did the two-reader engine case. Under `zh` the engine case read the packaged translation on BOTH readers, and under `en` it read the packaged English. The overlay sanity case and the no-overlay control passed.

Final head (`cb1b6888`, `origin/main` `6892888e` merged in):

- New and changed pins: `i18n-resolver.object-validations.test.ts` (four D9.2a cases: rewrite served as written, untouched rules translated, a rule the base does not declare keeps its own entry, no base means catalog as before, through `translateMetadataDocument('object')` too); `rule-validator.test.ts` (five evaluator cases, a `conditional` branch included); `engine-validation-tenant-rewrite.test.ts` (one real `SchemaRegistry` with a packaged owner, a tenant overlay and an `objectExtensions` contributor, the refusal of real writes beside `translateObject` with `getPackagedObjectBase` as `packagedBase`, for `zh-CN`, `zh` and `en`; plus a no-overlay control).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` under the verify lock: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 751 passed (751), Tests 22332 passed, 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test` under the verify lock: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 485 passed (485), Tests 9109 passed (9109).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` (with its `check:test-typecheck`): both VERDICT command-exit 0.

Ablation (negative pins). Each run uses `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed head `e7578942`. Every mutation was proven on disk (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed), and every restore matched the HEAD blob byte for byte. All three subjects resolve through `src` (relative imports), so no `dist` preflight applies:

1. `rule-validator.ts`: `scalarOverridesPackagedBase(messages.packagedRule?.(rule.name), 'message', rule.message)` replaced by `false`. 3 failed / 193 passed (196). The two evaluator rewrite cases went red, and so did the engine case, where only the refusal half differed from the served half.
2. `i18n-resolver.ts`: the `valueOverridesPackagedBase(packaged.get(rule.name), 'message', rule.message)` line deleted. 2 failed / 14 passed (16), the rewrite cases.
3. `engine.ts`: the host literal's `get registry()` line deleted. 1 failed / 2 passed (3), the engine case. This proves the wiring, not only the predicate.

The deviation in Acceptance notes is measured too. The final tests were run against the first implementation (`1a6b3305`), which counted a rule absent from the base as authored. `engine-validation-tenant-rewrite.test.ts` failed 2 of 3. The extension package's rule answered its English sentence under `zh-CN` and `zh`, both in the overlay group and in the no-overlay control.

## Acceptance notes

- **Deviation from the retriage's suggested shape (6487611040), measured.** The retriage read "A tenant rule with no packaged counterpart counts as authored." This PR does not do that: a rule the packaged owner's declaration does not carry has no packaged message to diverge from, so the catalog applies, as it does with no base at all (the predicate's own first edge). Reason: `objects.OBJECT._validations.RULE` also addresses rules an `objectExtensions` entry folds onto the object (`content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx`), the registry concatenates those rules into `validations`, and both `getPackagedObjectBase` and `getPackagedObjectOwner` answer the OWNER's declaration only. Counting an absent rule as authored served every extension package's translated rule in the source language, on both readers, with no tenant overlay at all. Measured: the engine test's extension rule, run against the first implementation (`1a6b3305`), went red in both the overlay group and the no-overlay control (zh-CN answered the English sentence); green on the final head. Unlike a list view, a rule is translated under its own name, which is why the list-view convention ("a view the base does not carry counts as diverged") is not copied here.
- **Not covered, outside the declared surface:** a tenant who rewrites the message of a rule that an `objectExtensions` entry contributed still gets that package's translation (the catalog applies, as before this PR; not a regression). Covering it needs the packaged base that `/meta` receives to include code extenders' rules, i.e. a change to where `@objectstack/rest` sources `packagedBase` (`packagedObjectBaseOf` / `getPackagedObjectBase`), and the same source on the refusal side so the two readers stay identical. Left to the seat to file or not.
- **One predicate; the lookup is walked twice.** The precedence test is `valueOverridesPackagedBase` on both readers (objectql reaches it through `scalarOverridesPackagedBase`). The by-name walk over the packaged `validations` (branches included, the same depth bound of 10, first name wins) exists once per package: `packagedRulesByName` in `i18n-resolver.ts` and `packagedRuleLookup` in `engine-validation-messages.ts`. Sharing it would need a new `@objectstack/spec/system` export, which regenerates `packages/spec/api-surface/system.json` and `export-origins/system.json`, outside "nothing else under packages/spec".
- **`ObjectQL#validationMessageContext`'s declared return type** in `engine.ts` still names `locale` / `translate` / `objectName` only; the object it returns carries `packagedRule` too and reaches the validators unchanged. Widening the declaration is a second `engine.ts` hunk, outside the approved host-literal edit.
- **In-flight intersection (grant 6488299876).** The file lists of the 22 open non-mailbox PRs read at 2026-10-29T11:27Z: none touches `i18n-resolver.ts`, `rule-validator.ts`, `record-validator.ts` or `engine-validation-messages.ts`; only #27477 touches `engine.ts` (hunks L13315–20160 per the seat; this PR's hunk is at L9548), and `git merge-tree --write-tree` of this head with #27477's head `5eb62f09` is clean. The three `pm:mailbox` PRs were not read; the Version Packages PR #26517 hits none of these files on its first 100. Since then `origin/main` gained four commits (to `d4ff1a02`, read at 12:05Z), none touching this PR's nine files; `git merge-tree --write-tree` of this head with it is clean.
- **Branch name.** `claude/project-thread-i8f8j5` is the card thread's harness-pinned branch and names no issue; the claim (6495130451) is the identity record.
- **Contract review owed** on this PR's head before the maintainer is asked to approve (it touches `packages/spec`, #27345).

## Verification

Derived local subset on the final head `cb1b6888`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, no paths, against merge base `6892888e4`, 9 paths, 589 changed lines. Every one of the 85 commands was run and its exit code captured before any pipe. The reconciliation `--ran`: "85 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 85 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 85 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". Two first answered exit 3 (a prerequisite, not a verdict) and were re-run green:

- `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` passed after fetching its pinned fixture commit: 48 cases.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` passed after a full `turbo run build`: 115/115 tasks.

Also run:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date". No artifact under `packages/spec` moves.
- `check:dev-prereqs` and `check:skill-frame-freshness` (local-only): exit 0.

Repo-wide lint and the CI-owned families are read from this PR's check-runs.
